programme.title: [rec]
programme.desc: Una reportera está haciendo un reportaje en una estación de bomberos. Atrapados en el interior de un edificio, los bomberos y el equipo de televisión tendrán que enfrentarse a algo siniestro y maligno, esconderse y tratar desesperadamente de escapar.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: El grupo explora las ruinas de un antiguo canal de TV mientras intentan contactar con Kaya en su campamento.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: En Chicago, Doc y Murphy se topan con un misterioso y violento grupo, incluyendo a Sketchy y Skeezy.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: El grupo busca otro objeto de los sueños de Warren en los Laboratorios Mercy, donde conocieron a El Hombre.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: En Monte Weather, el grupo descubre que necesitan la huella del presidente para cumplir el objetivo de Warren.

programme.title: Alarma en el Expreso
programme.desc: Centroeuropa. El tren Transcontinental sufre un retraso. Los pasajeros pernoctan en un hotel. Iris Henderson habla con una anciana, la Sra. Froy. En el tren, Iris se da cuenta de la desaparición de la anciana, pero los pasajeros afirman que no existe.

programme.title: El autoestopista
programme.desc: Dos pescadores recogen a un autoestopista que resulta ser un convicto psicótico.

programme.title: El ministerio del miedo
programme.desc: Tras dos años de reclusión, Stephen Neale abandona el sanatorio mental de Lembridge. Se encuentra entonces con un mundo distinto que nada tiene que ver con lo que él conocía.

programme.title: El doble asesinato en la calle Morgue
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, un sádico doctor de París se dedica a secuestrar a mujeres jóvenes para realizar experimentos que puedan ayudarle a confirmar sus teorías sobre la evolución del mono al hombre.

programme.title: Barba azul
programme.desc: Un peligroso asesino, apodado Barba Azul, tiene aterrorizados a los habitantes de París. A todos menos a Lucille, una modesta costurera que, desoyendo el clamor popular, decide salir a dar un paseo nocturno por la ciudad.

programme.title: Fear X
programme.desc: Harry (John Turturro), un agente de seguridad de un centro comercial, se dedica a investigar obsesivamente el asesinato de su mujer.

programme.title: Esposa desconocida
programme.desc: Los celos arruinan la vida amorosa de Georgia. El día de su boda, sus miedos regresan y todo se complica.

programme.title: Instafama
programme.desc: Una fanática desquiciada de las redes sociales inculpa a su mejor amiga por asesinato.

programme.title: Secuestrada en la isla
programme.desc: Una madre soltera arriesga su vida para salvar a su hija, fascinada por las estrellas, de las garras de una red de tráfico sexual dirigida por un agente de talentos en una isla aislada.

programme.title: Puntos extra por asesinato
programme.desc: Maisy se traslada a la universidad de su difunta hermana para investigar las circunstancias de su muerte.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Una prostituta convertida en traficante de drogas pretende apoderarse de la ciudad futurista de Mega City One. El Juez Dredd, miembro destacado de una fuerza policial de élite, es la última esperanza de la ciudad.

programme.title: Mi obsesión por Rachel
programme.desc: Rachel inicia una relación con Craig, un hombre encantador que irrumpe en su vida con un romanticismo inesperado. Todo parece perfecto… hasta que su verdadera personalidad comienza a salir a la luz.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Todo el Océano del Gran Neptuno
programme.desc: Los Castalians abordan el Andrómeda para finalizar la carta de la Nueva Mancomunidad. Cuando el líder es descubierto muerto, Tyr es el principal sospechoso.
programme.sub-title: Todo el Océano del Gran Neptuno

programme.title: Andrómeda: Las Perlas Que Fueron Sus Ojos
programme.desc: Beka se entera de que el ex socio de negocios de su padre se ocupa de una droga altamente adictiva llamada Flash.
programme.sub-title: Las Perlas Que Fueron Sus Ojos

programme.title: Andrómeda: Las Matemáticas de las Lágrimas
programme.desc: La Andrómeda descubre su nave hermana, la Pax Magellanic. La tripulación a bordo del Pax tiene 300 años, pero no ha envejecido ni un día.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Música de un Tambor Distante
programme.desc: Tyr se estrella contra el Eureka Maru en un planeta Nietzschean y desarrolla amnesia. Debe recordar lo que está haciendo antes de que los Nietzscheans lo descubran a él y a su caja de bienes robados.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper recibe el don del conocimiento de un Perseid moribundo, sólo para descubrir que el Perseid estaba siendo buscado por un cazarrecompensas que ahora ha vuelto su atención a Harper.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Perspectiva Forzada
programme.desc: Dylan fue arrestado por asesinar a un dictador hace 300 años.

programme.title: Andrómeda: La Suma de Sus Partes
programme.desc: Andrómeda está embarcada por un dron del Consenso de Partes, una sociedad mecánica mítica. Mientras que amistoso al principio, el dron intenta forzar a la nave a unirse al Consenso.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Miedo y Desprecio en la Vía Láctea
programme.desc: Gerentex está de vuelta, y exige que Trance y Harper lo ayuden con su nuevo plan: encontrar a Tarn-Vedra.
programme.sub-title: Miedo y Desprecio en la Vía Láctea

programme.title: Andrómeda: El Diablo se Lleva lo Último
programme.desc: Dylan y el reverendo Bem ayudan a una sociedad pacífica a hacer frente a sus posibles esclavos. Tienen que tener cuidado porque si Dylan les enseña a matar, sus hijos nacerán sabiendo.
programme.sub-title: El Diablo se Lleva lo Último

programme.title: Andrómeda: Cruce de Estrellas
programme.desc: El avatar de Rommie se enamora de lo que resulta ser el avatar de un buque de guerra llamado Gabriel. Gabriel intenta infectar a Rommie con un virus que difunde sus planes a la nave de guerra.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Hace una Luz Encantadora
programme.desc: Beka lleva la Andrómeda a Tarn-Vedra, pero el tiempo prolongado en la corriente de deslizamiento causa efectos secundarios. Para combatirlos, Beka comienza a tomar Flash y pronto se vuelve adicto.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan y Rommie deben rescatar a Tyr, Harper y Rev de un Magog Worldship.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev y Tyr se estrellan después de escapar de una banda de Nietzscheans, pero pronto se enfrentan a una nueva amenaza: la necesidad de Rev de alimentarse.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: La tripulación debe robar una joya que está en el centro de una disputa entre un dueño de Drift y el Than. Beka se enamora de un jefe de seguridad que antes era un ladrón.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Andrómeda responde a una llamada de socorro cuando un barco de carga es atacado.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: La tripulación busca a un líder de la Mancomunidad perdido hace mucho tiempo que se ha escondido.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka y Trance van con Rommie para averiguar cómo se está desarrollando un arma en un planeta que desconfía de la IA.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Andrómeda tiene la tarea de escoltar naves médicas de forma segura a través del espacio Drago-Kazov.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Un planeta de sobrevivientes de la Mancomunidad liderados por la ex prometida de Dylan es invitado a unirse a la nueva Mancomunidad, pero cuando votan para no unirse, los Magog son sospechosos de jugar sucio.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Un agente del Abismo intenta atraer a Harper para que se una al Magog.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Cuando rescatan a un joven príncipe de un levantamiento que mata al resto de su familia, se les pide a Dylan y Tyr que sean sus asesores.

programme.desc: Hours after his release from prison, Jesus Quintana pairs up with fellow misfits Petey and Marie for a freewheeling joyride of petty crime and romance.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: When dangerous street thug James "Animal" Allen (Ving Rhames) is sent to prison, he continues his violent ways working for fellow inmate Kassada (Chazz Palminteri). This changes after Animal encounters Berwell (Jim Brown), a revolutionary who introduces him to the writings of Malcolm X. Animal reforms, realizing that murder and crime are destroying his community. After Animal is released, he goes home to find his son, Darius (Terrence Dashon Howard), involved in gang activity just like he was.

programme.title: Black Water
programme.desc: A deep cover operative awakens to find himself imprisoned on a submarine. With the help of a fellow prisoner and an amateur agent, he must race against the clock to escape the vessel and expose who set him up.

programme.title: Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: A young woman must foil the terrorist who killed her parents before he strikes again on the island of Nantucket.

programme.title: Fruitvale Station
programme.desc: Though he once spent time in San Quentin, 22-year-old black man Oscar Grant (Michael B. Jordan) is now trying hard to live a clean life and support his girlfriend (Melonie Diaz) and young daughter (Ariana Neal). Flashbacks reveal the last day in Oscar's life, in which he accompanied his family and friends to San Francisco to watch fireworks on New Year's Eve, and, on the way back home, became swept up in an altercation with police that ended in tragedy. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: Determined to help at-risk youths avoid the mistakes he made, an ex-con (Cuba Gooding Jr.) forms a chess club to offer them an alternative to running with street gangs.

programme.title: Rock the Kasbah
programme.desc: While visiting Kabul, Afghanistan, washed-up music manager Richie Lanz (Bill Murray) gets dumped by his last client. His luck changes when he meets Salima Khan (Leem Lubany), a Pashtun teenager with a beautiful voice who dreams of becoming the first female to compete on the television show "Afghan Star." With help from a savvy hooker (Kate Hudson), two war profiteers and a trigger-happy mercenary (Bruce Willis), Richie embarks on a mission to make sure his new protégée gets discovered.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Teenage Sarah (Jennifer Connelly) journeys through a maze to recover her baby brother (Toby Froud) from a goblin king (David Bowie).

programme.title: The Paperboy
programme.desc: In 1969 Florida, reporter Ward Jansen (Matthew McConaughey) returns to his hometown to write a story about death-row inmate Hillary Van Wetter (John Cusack), who was convicted of murdering a racist lawman. Ward hires his younger brother, Jack (Zac Efron), as a driver and, together with his partner, Yardley (David Oyelowo), gets to work. Though the possibility exists that Van Wetter is innocent, Ward and Yardley unwisely trust a vixen (Nicole Kidman) who will do anything to set the convict free.

The group, which includes the thespian-averse technology expert Chris (Matt Stone), not only has to face off against Jong-il, but they must also contend with F.A.G., the Film Actors Guild, a cadre of Hollywood liberals at odds with Team America's "policing the world" tactics.

While the drug-ingesting duo is soon arrested for possession of marijuana, Anthony and Pedro get released on a technicality, allowing them to continue their many misadventures and ultimately compete in a rock band contest, where they perform the raucous tune "Earache My Eye."

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoune (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Canton (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. programme.title: Astrud Gilberto & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: Gilberto, Gillespie & Skymasters - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, Dutch big band The Skymasters accompanied monumental jazz trumpet legend Dizzy Gillespie and the Brazilian bossa nova singer Astrud Gilberto at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: La Velle
programme.sub-title: Rhoda Scott & La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. "It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.” This performance at the French Festival Jazz à Vienne is extra special. Not only because of the beautiful location, but also because she shares the stage with American gospel and blues singer La Velle. Together they give an intimate and beautiful show in the antique theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick
programme.sub-title: Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in 's-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wycliffe Gordon
programme.sub-title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning'. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms. Marsalis's Septet was made up of Wess Anderson (alto saxophone), Wycliffe Gordon (trombone), Reginald Veal (bass), Herlin Riley (drums), Todd Williams (tenor saxophone), and Eric Reed (piano).

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Thomas Dunford
programme.sub-title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995 Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007 and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004. Paris-born lutenist Thomas Dunford (*1988) discovered the lute at the age of nine. He studied at the Conservatory of Paris and the Schola Cantorum in Basel, and participated in masterclasses with lutenists such as Rolf Lislevand and Julian Bream. He has made various solo and ensemble appearances at Europe's most prestigious festivals.

programme.title: Luca Vignali, Angelo De Angelis, Carmine Pinto & Eliseo Smordoni
programme.sub-title: Mozart - Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452. The work premiered at the Viennese Burgtheater on April 1, 1784, with the composer himself at the piano. Shortly after the performance, Mozart wrote to his father Leopold, “I consider it the best work I have ever written…”. Striking is the Quintet's unusual instrumentation, which presented the composer with a challenge “as single winds, as opposed to pairs, pose problems of blend”. Therefore, Mozart explored numerous different permutations of instruments to produce various sonorities, and used short phrases and motifs for variety. This performance was recorded at Perugia's Auditorium Santa Cecilia, Italy, on June 23, 2022.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto, Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Ruxandra Donose & Ramón Vargas
programme.sub-title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler's song-symphony — one of the composer's most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6 and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: A Random Encounter
programme.desc: Starring the charming Meghan Markle (Suits), this whirlwind rom-com proves that finding Prince Charming can be a right royal pain. Sassy Mindy is well and truly immersed in the superficial dating scene, while her best friend Laura is a hopeless romantic. So when she has a chance moment with a stranger in a coffee shop, she is left wondering whether this could blossom into a lifelong romance?

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: A brilliantly hilarious "in tents" comedy drama, starring David Arquette, Amy Acker and Academy Award nominee June Squibb. With their marriage on the rocks, Jack and Amanda head off on a glamping trip to "reignite their spark". But when their blissful romantic getaway is hijacked by a pair of hipster honeymooners and a hunky land-owner, they are left in more trouble than before!

programme.title: Mr. Jones
programme.desc: A highly-compelling political thriller from award-winning director Agniezka Holland. Welsh journalist Gareth Jones (James Norton: Little Women) risks his life to expose the truth about the devastating famine in the Soviet Union in the early 1930s. Also starring Vanessa Kirby (The Crown) and Golden Globe Nominee Peter Sarsgaard (The Batman). This is the most important true story you will ever see.

programme.title: Assassin
programme.desc: Danny Dyer (Eastenders) is back on top form in Assassin, a brutal, hard-hitting story of Jamie, a former hitman out for revenge. Starring Martin Kemp (The Krays), Gary Kemp (The World's End), and from the producers of Rise of the Footsoldier and Goodfellas, Assassin is the story of the most corrupt crime bosses in the London underworld, and one man's crusade to bring them to justice.

programme.title: The World We Make
programme.desc: 18 year old Lee (a spirited equestrian) and Jordan (an academic and football standout) are at the threshold of building a life together. But their character is tested when racial bias surfaces in their otherwise progressive small town.

programme.title: Resistance
programme.desc: 1944, when the women from a Welsh village find their husbands are missing, they must work with a German platoon to survive.

programme.title: Astronaut
programme.desc: Richard Dreyfuss stars as a lonely widower who lies about his age when entering a competition to win a trip into space

programme.title: Away From Her
programme.desc: A double-Oscar-nominated, beautifully subtle exploration of Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: A Merry Christmas Match
programme.desc: (2019) Charming Christmas romance with Ashley Newbrough. After years of working in her mother's small-town antique shop, a woman wonders if she needs something new after meeting a handsome stranger.

programme.title: Christmas Wishes and Mistletoe Kisses
programme.desc: (2019) Seasonal romance with Jill Wagner. A wealthy businessman hires an interior designer to add some festive spirit to his home, and soon finds his life touched by her cheerful presence.

programme.title: Welcome To Christmas
programme.desc: (2018) Festive romance with Eric Mabius. Developer Madison visits Christmas, Colorado, for a ski resort development plan but finds community and holiday magic. Will progress threaten the town's charm?

programme.title: Christmas in Toyland
programme.desc: (2022) Festive rom-com with Vanessa Lengies. Data analyst Charlie is sent to a thriving toy shop to replicate its formula. Can manager Grant's secrets to success open her mind... and heart?

programme.title: The Christmas Pageant
programme.desc: (2011) Festive romance starring Melissa Gilbert. A temperamental director is forced to direct a Christmas pageant. She finds herself swept up by the magic of Christmas, and an ex-lover.

programme.title: Just for the Summer
programme.desc: Teacher Penelope Campbell loves visiting her Grandma Dot every summer – despite her constant attempts to find Penelope a man! This year, she bumps into her childhood sweetheart Jason Humphrey, who explains his grandmother is desperate to pair him off, too.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: Workaholic Jillian inherits a beautiful mountainside cabin after her long-lost, wealthy uncle dies.

programme.title: The Charm of Love
programme.desc: Art historian Madison “Maddie” TURNER, an expert in ancient artifacts and in deflecting unwanted male attention, travels halfway around the world to the Caribbeans in order to find the legendary "Lovers Stone".

programme.title: Tailor-Made Romance
programme.desc: A struggling designer takes a job as a personal stylist for a grumpy but ridiculously handsome billionaire. As she revamps his wardrobe and he teaches her about business, they realize they just might be the perfect fit.

programme.title: Our Dream Wedding
programme.desc: Commitment-shy Haley is as anti-marriage as it gets, but when she tries on her grandma's ‘magical' wedding veil, she's transported to her future, where she and long-term boyfriend Scott are happily married with two beautiful children.

programme.title: Holiday Road Trip
programme.desc: Two feuding business associates fall for each other while escorting a celebrity dog on a Christmas promotional tour.

programme.title: Love Notes
programme.desc: Starring Laura Leighton and Antonio Cupo. When a classical music critic becomes pregnant from a brief encounter with a country music star, she decides it is the perfect way for her infertile best friend to have a baby.

programme.title: Back To Love
programme.desc: A young widow returns home for the first time in three years to help prepare her sister's wedding. She is forced to confront her past, including the man she never expected to fall for.

programme.title: 2 Years of Love
programme.desc: Samantha has a great marriage, until the pressure to have a baby comes up. Things get tricky when she starts falling for one of her clients, not realizing it is secretly her husband. Will they be able to make it through this rough patch?

programme.title: Sweet Home Carolina
programme.desc: Diane is a struggling single mom in LA. Just when things are at their worst, but she will have to live in small town USA for a year and take care of a dog for a year before the house is hers.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God's protection and Derek's assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek's own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: God Bless The Broken Road
programme.desc: God Bless the Broken Road tells the story of a young mother who loses her husband in Afghanistan and struggles to raise their young daughter in his absence. The film combines elements of faith, country music, and stock car racing while paying tribute to those who serve in the United States Military.

programme.title: You're So Cupid
programme.desc: Fraternal twin sisters Emma and Lilly are as different as night and day but both have an insatiable desire to play matchmaker. Why? Because their father is actually Cupid! Life gets complicated when they discover they're in love with the same guy and they become bitter rivals as they try to win his affection. But can Emma and Lily overcome their problems and use their matchmaking skills to bring their divorcing parents back together?

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: Passionate fashion stylist Rose is in her 30s and living in New York. When she inherits her grandmother's vintage dress shop, she returns to her small hometown to take care of the store and bumps into her high school crush Cole.

programme.title: Buried in Barstow
programme.desc: Angie Harmon plays Hazel King, a single mom concealing her past.

programme.title: Death Saved My Life
programme.desc: Jade (Meagan Good) appears perfect but her life is far from idyllic behind doors.

programme.title: Escaping My Stalker
programme.desc: Taylor lived on the streets until she was taken in by Larry and Sandy Stewart.

programme.title: Parents Gone Bad
programme.desc: Stories of mothers and fathers who made headlines by committing crimes.

programme.title: Buried in Barstow
programme.desc: Angie Harmon plays Hazel King, a single mom concealing her past.

programme.title: Stolen Dreams
programme.desc: Laura Paddington is overcome with joy when her daughter, Zoe, returns to her after being abducted 17 years before--but is Zoe really her long lost child?

programme.title: The Perfect Cheerleader
programme.desc: Cassie's dream cheerleading squad takes a dark turn when a new man and a murder uncover a deadly conspiracy.

programme.title: Sweet Autumn
programme.desc: Maggie inherits half of her aunt's maple business and teams up with Dex to uncover the truth behind her will.

programme.title: Killer Reputation
programme.desc: A PR maven takes pride in her reputation, but she risks it to help a star accused of killing his ex-wife.

programme.title: Paul Blart
programme.desc: In Columbia Pictures' comedy Paul Blart: Mall Cop, Kevin James stars as the title character, a single, suburban dad, trying to make ends meet as a security officer at a New Jersey mall. Though no one else takes his job seriously, Paul considers himself on the front lines of safety. When a heist shuts down the megaplex, Jersey's most formidable mall cop will have to become a real cop to save the day.

programme.title: Paul Blart
programme.desc: After six years of keeping our malls safe, Paul Blart (Kevin James) has earned a vacation. He heads to Vegas with his teenage daughter and finds that safety never takes a holiday. When duty calls, Blart answers.

programme.title: You Don't Mess With The Zohan
programme.desc: A Mossad agent fakes his death so he can re-emerge in New York City as a hair stylist.

programme.title: Here Comes The Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches in order to raise money to save the music program at his school.

programme.title: Girl Most Likely
programme.desc: Kristen Wiig stars as Imogene, once a promising young New York playwright whose promise has fizzled, thanks to a crisis of confidence. Heavily in denial about being dumped by her society boyfriend, Imogene uses her skill for drama to stage an elaborate fake suicide as an appeal for his sympathy.

programme.title: Father of Invention
programme.desc: Robert Axle (Kevin Spacey of AMERICAN BEAUTY, HORRIBLE BOSSES), an eccentric inventor-turned-egomaniacal-infomercial-guru, loses it all when one of his inventions maims thousands of customers.

programme.title: Switched
programme.desc: Tired of being bullied, Cassandra Evans prays that her nemesis, Katie Sharp, the queen bee of social media, would know what it's like to walk a day in her shoes. Her prayer is answered in an unexpected way when they get "Switched."

programme.title: As of Yet
programme.desc: Told entirely through video calls and digital diaries, Naomi navigates a problematic roommate and a burgeoning romance all while locked down during the Coronavirus pandemic.

programme.title: Vampires Suck
programme.desc: Becca, an anxious, non-vampire teen, is torn between two boys. Before she can choose, Becca must get around her controlling father, who embarrasses Becca by treating her like a child. Meanwhile, Becca's friends contend with their own romantic issues, all of which collide at the prom.

programme.title: The Over the Hill Gang
programme.desc: A retired Texas Ranger and his three aging pals are hired to clean up a lawless town.

programme.title: Wyatt Earp S01E21-24
programme.desc: In one of television's first adult Westerns, the famous marshal puts his life on the line to maintain order, first in Dodge City, Kan., then in Tombstone, Ariz.

programme.title: Utah Blaine
programme.desc: Gunslinger Utah Blaine rescues rancher Joe Neal from lynching by vigilante land-grabbers and runs afoul of vigilante leader Russ Nevers' interests.

programme.title: No Killing Without Dollars
programme.desc: Lawrence White returns to Owell Rock seeking revenge for his father's murder. To protect his identity and strategy, he adopts a new name and hires another man to impersonate Lawrence White, setting a dangerous game of deception and vengeance in motion.

programme.title: New Frontier (1939)
programme.desc: The state government plans to build a flood-control dam and condemns the property of the local farmers and ranchers, including The Three Mesquiteers. The state intends to compensate the land-owners fairly, but a crooked real-estate promoter complicates things. The ranchers, led by Stony Brooke ('John Wayne' (q)), Tucson Smith ('Ray Corrigan') and Rusty Joslin (Raymond Hatton) fight back against both the law and the crooks.

programme.title: The Singer Not the Song
programme.desc: Dramatic western about a murderous bandit who terrorises a Mexican village, and the idealistic Irish priest.

programme.title: Miss London Limited
programme.desc: Arthur's business is in a mess. He supplies visiting troops with female escorts.

programme.title: The Divorce of Lady X
programme.desc: Laurence Olivier plays Logan, a divorce lawyer, stranded in overcrowded hotel.

programme.title: A Window in London
programme.desc: A man who witnesses a murder through the windows of a passing train tries to track down the killer.

programme.title: Myth of the Maze
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel and Claudia visit Athens, Greece to search the Minotaur's maze for the legendary golden twine.

programme.title: Afterlife and Death
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are in Cairo, Egypt and then Amsterdam. They must beat rival relic hunter Avery Ko to the Pharaoh Thutmose's diamond before it is cut up and sold.

programme.title: Etched in Stone
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel and Stewie Harper head to Stockholm, Sweden to find the Runestone of King Jann I of Norway.

programme.title: Irish Crown Affair
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel head to Dublin, Ireland in search of the missing crown of the last King of Ireland.

programme.title: A Vanishing Art
programme.desc: Accompanying Max the magician, Sydney and Nigel journey to Atlantic City, New Jersey in search of Hungary's lost and allegedly cursed Royal Scepter.

programme.title: Love Letter
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to France to look for the lost wedding vows of Josephine Pontoise and Guy de Bourdin, which would prove their heir is the rightful owner of St. Agnes Sur-Loire.

programme.title: A Good Year
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel travel to France to find the lost stones from Marie Antoinette's Crown.

programme.title: The Double
programme.desc: An edge-of-your-seat espionage thriller, starring Richard Gere and Topher Grace as ex-CIA and FBI agents, trying to find the killer of a US senator, which bears the hallmark of an infamous Soviet assassin, thought to be dead.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Strangers use improvised weapons, adrenaline and sheer guts to mount a defense against murderous bikers and their survival depends on doing the unthinkable - fighting for their lives!

programme.title: Dominion: The Last Star Warrior
programme.desc: In five days the world changed. As a retired Intelligence agent turned UFO investigator races to discover the fate of the human race, an alien observer searchs for the human woman he loves.

programme.title: A Perfect Plan
programme.desc: Four notorious thieves wake up in a fortified warehouse and are forced to commit an audacious diamond heist to win their freedom.

programme.title: Superfast!
programme.desc: Undercover cop, Paul White joins Vin Serento's LA gang of illegal street racers as they plan to double cross LA's crime kingpin. The gang's outrageous wheel-spinning plan is as daring as it is ridiculous and will see them towing the whole damn restaurant, at crazy speeds, half way across the city.

programme.title: The Bone Collector
programme.desc: A paralyzed forensics expert and a young policewoman must work together to stop a brutal serial killer.

programme.title: Gloria (1980)
programme.desc: Rowlands garnered an Oscar nomination for her fierce portrayal as an ex-mob mistress who takes care of a young boy after his family is wiped out by the Mafia. Gloria must rely on all her street-savvy to prevent both herself and the boy from being the mobster's next target.

programme.title: Suspect (1987)
programme.desc: This tension-filled courtroom drama opens with the suicide of a Supreme Court justice. Then the young Justice Department employee to whom he had given privileged information is discovered dead. A deaf-mute Vietnam veteran is charged with her murder and Cher, a public defender, is appointed counsel.

programme.title: Gridiron Gang (2006)
programme.desc: Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson (The Rundown, Walking Tall) stars in this gritty and inspirational movie, based on a true story about a group of teenage delinquents given a second chance to redeem themselves by playing football.

programme.desc: A writer with a room for rent acquires a strange new roommate with a psychotic alter-ego that follows her wherever she goes.

programme.title: Spotlight [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: Arlington Road [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: Dog Soldiers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: During a routine nighttime training mission in the Scottish Highlands, a small squad of British soldiers expected to rendezvous with a special ops unit instead find a bloody massacre with a sole survivor. The savage attackers of the special ops team return, and the men are rescued by Megan, a zoologist who identifies what hunts them as werewolves. Without transport or communications, the group is forced to retreat to a farmhouse to wait for the full moon to disappear at dawn.

programme.title: Hard Boiled [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A tough-as-nails cop teams up with an undercover agent to shut down a sinister mobster and his crew.

programme.title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
programme.desc: An unexplained phenomenon has struck the Earth. Contact between most towns on Earth has been severed. A small area in Eastern Europe is the only location that still has electricity. When military forces venture outside, they discover a shocking truth - corpses everywhere. In stores, in cars, on roads, in hospitals and railway stations. Who or what is destroying all life on Earth? And how long can the last outpost of mankind endure?

programme.title: La boutique des secrets
programme.desc: Jennifer veut aider Tamara à ouvrir une boîte à secret fabriquée par sa belle-mère. Mais la boîte disparaît et Tamara est retrouvée morte.

programme.title: La boutique des secrets
programme.desc: Dans un local d'entreposage lors d'une vente aux enchères, Jennifer découvre le corps sans vie d'une femme.

programme.title: La boutique des secrets
programme.desc: Jennifer est contactée pour vendre la collection d'appareils photo de Larry, un sexagénaire retrouvé mort lors de sa fête d'anniversaire.

programme.title: La boutique des secrets
programme.desc: En menant sa petite enquête, Jennifer découvre que l'ancien propriétaire d'un piano mécanique a été mêlé à des vols d'oeuvres d'art.

programme.desc: Lori est bouleversée lorsque sa meilleure amie se noie dans des circonstances mystérieuses lors d'une sortie en bateau avec son mari Randy.

programme.title: Murderers' Row

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: Gilberto, Gillespie & Skymasters - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, Dutch big band The Skymasters accompanied monumental jazz trumpet legend Dizzy Gillespie and the Brazilian bossa nova singer Astrud Gilberto at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: La Velle
programme.sub-title: Rhoda Scott & La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. "It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.” This performance at the French Festival Jazz à Vienne is extra special. Not only because of the beautiful location, but also because she shares the stage with American gospel and blues singer La Velle. Together they give an intimate and beautiful show in the antique theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick
programme.sub-title: Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in 's-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wycliffe Gordon
programme.sub-title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning'. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms. Marsalis's Septet was made up of Wess Anderson (alto saxophone), Wycliffe Gordon (trombone), Reginald Veal (bass), Herlin Riley (drums), Todd Williams (tenor saxophone), and Eric Reed (piano).

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Thomas Dunford
programme.sub-title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995 Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007 and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004. Paris-born lutenist Thomas Dunford (*1988) discovered the lute at the age of nine. He studied at the Conservatory of Paris and the Schola Cantorum in Basel, and participated in masterclasses with lutenists such as Rolf Lislevand and Julian Bream. He has made various solo and ensemble appearances at Europe's most prestigious festivals.

programme.title: Luca Vignali, Angelo De Angelis, Carmine Pinto & Eliseo Smordoni
programme.sub-title: Mozart - Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452. The work premiered at the Viennese Burgtheater on April 1, 1784, with the composer himself at the piano. Shortly after the performance, Mozart wrote to his father Leopold, “I consider it the best work I have ever written…”. Striking is the Quintet's unusual instrumentation, which presented the composer with a challenge “as single winds, as opposed to pairs, pose problems of blend”. Therefore, Mozart explored numerous different permutations of instruments to produce various sonorities, and used short phrases and motifs for variety. This performance was recorded at Perugia's Auditorium Santa Cecilia, Italy, on June 23, 2022.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto, Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Ruxandra Donose & Ramón Vargas
programme.sub-title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler's song-symphony — one of the composer's most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6 and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Asesino de tiburones
programme.desc: Los servicios del asesino de tiburones Chase Walker han sido contratados por su hermano Jake, jefe de una banda criminal de la Costa Oeste. El trabajo: matar al tiburón de aleta negra que se tragó un valioso diamante durante una transacción entre bandas. Para vigilar a Chase, se alista a Jasmine, colega de Jake. Pero la relación entre Chase y Jasmine se profundiza con las amenazas de un jefe rival: llevarle el diamante o morir. Pronto, las lealtades cambiarán, y Chase aprenderá que confiar en la sangre es para tontos. Ahora, se enfrentan jefes contra jefes, hermanos contra hermanos y el hombre contra la naturaleza, mientras Chase se esfuerza por rescatar a Jasmine, salvar su propia vida y rastrear al gran tiburón de aleta negra que será el mayor desafío de su carrera.

programme.title: H4zard
programme.desc: Sigue a Noah, quien realmente ama a su novia, a su hija y a su coche, pero después de aceptar un trabajo como conductor, se ve envuelto en una carrera que podría costarle la vida, su familia o su querido automóvil.

programme.title: Los Supervivientes
programme.desc: Samuel, un hombre que vive en los Alpes italianos, decide ayudar a Chehreh, una mujer afgana, a llegar a Francia. Tendrán que enfrentarse a una naturaleza hostil y a la crueldad de los hombres que habitan este territorio.

programme.title: Piel
programme.desc: Un notorio skinhead se enamora de una mujer y sus tres hijas, y se somete a dolorosos tratamientos para eliminar los tatuajes que cubren todo su rostro y cuerpo, la representación física del odio que mostró al mundo durante más de la mitad de su vida. Basada en la historia real de Bryon Widner.

programme.title: La abeja Maya: el orbe dorado
programme.desc: Maya, una abeja testaruda, y su amigo Willi se enfrentan a una épica batalla de insectos.

programme.title: Juego del Amor, El
programme.desc: Frances, la ex-esposa de Jake, conspira con sus hijos, para obligarlo a vender su amado equipo de baloncesto de Seattle. ¿Será que el juego sale de la cancha para encender chispas románticas?

programme.title: Oscuro deseo
programme.desc: Un joven desesperado por conectarse con las personas cercanas a él recurre a medidas extremas para lograrlo.

programme.title: La Sospechosa
programme.desc: Beth ha sido acusada de matar a su marido. Todos creen que es culpable, hasta que aparece Jerry, un investigador de una aseguradora que le da el beneficio de la duda.

programme.title: Identidad en la Sombra
programme.desc: En 1999, un acosador cibernético acaba matando a los padres de su víctima. 15 años después, la superviviente vive en un nuevo lugar y con otra identidad, porque el asesino aún anda suelto.

programme.title: Los girasoles
programme.desc: Giovanna y Antonio, dos jóvenes napolitanos, se casan doce días antes del comienzo de la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Unos años más tarde, Antonio es dado por desaparecido en el frente ruso pero su esposa se niega a olvidarle. Armada con una fotografía de su amado, Giovanna viaja incansablemente por Rusia para encontrarle cueste lo que cueste.

programme.title: Relámpago sobre agua
programme.desc: Los últimos días del gran director de cine americano Nicholas Ray, conocido por films como “Rebelde sin causa” o “Johnny Guitar”. Cuando se estaba muriendo de cáncer, Ray se negó a ir a un hospital y prefirió quedarse en su loft de Nueva York, rodeado de sus mejores amigos. Wim Wenders conoció a Nicholas Ray en 1976 durante el rodaje de “El amigo americano”. “Sabía que quería trabajar y morir trabajando” dice Wim Wenders en la película. Ray habla de los distintos artistas que intervinieron en sus películas.

programme.title: The Hit (La venganza)
programme.desc: None

programme.title: Zazie en el metro
programme.desc: Zazie es una niña traviesa de doce años que llega a París para pasar un tiempo con su tío Gabriel. Con él visita la ciudad, aunque ella solo tiene una cosa en mente: viajar en metro. Pero está en huelga. Es en el taxi de Charles, un amigo de su tío, donde Zazie inicia sus tres días de endiablada vida parisina.

programme.title: Sueños eléctricos
programme.desc: Un triángulo amoroso entre un hombre, una mujer y una máquina.

programme.title: En Compañía de Lobos
programme.desc: Lobos y criaturas fantásticas acechan los sueños de la joven Rosaleen, quien sueña que debe atravesar el bosque oscuro para llegar a casa de su abuela.

programme.title: El Lute II: Mañana seré libre
programme.desc: El Lute escapa de la prisión de El Puerto de Santa María. Lo primero que hace tras su huida es acudir a sus hermanos para pedirles ayuda.

programme.title: El Lute: Camina o Revienta
programme.desc: En 1960, una familia de quinquis recorre Extremadura. La vida tan dura que llevan causa la muerte de la madre. El hijo, Eleuterio Sánchez, roba unas gallinas y es condenado a seis meses de cárcel...

programme.title: 1492: La conquista del paraíso
programme.desc: Retrata la vida del atrevido explorador Cristóbal Colón. Un difícil y sorprendente viaje hasta una tierra desconocida por el mundo, América el efecto sobre las tribus indígenas y la vuelta del héroe a España hasta su muerte.

programme.title: Valkiria
programme.desc: En plena Segunda Guerra Mundial, un grupo de altos mandos alemanes desarrollan un plan para asesinar a Hitler.

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott regresa a casa en Woodsboro. Pero su vuelta traerá también a su viejo enemigo: Ghostface.

programme.title: Mami Nunca Te Haría Daño
programme.desc: Riley no quiere otra cosa sino reconstruir la relación con su madre y su hermana pequeña.

programme.title: Parejas Criminales
programme.desc: Mario contrata a un director famoso para su comercial. Karen aprende cómo es conducir en Staten Island.

programme.title: Desafío
programme.desc: lo que empieza siendo un juego divertido y desenfadado acabará por convertirse en una auténtica pesadilla.

programme.title: Un puente hacia Terabithia
programme.desc: Jess Aarons se siente extraño tanto en el colegio como en su propia casa. Se ha entrenado durante todo el verano para ser el más rápido de su clase, pero su objetivo se ve frustrado por la nueva chica del colegio. A pesar de ello, pronto se hacen amigos y crean el reino secreto de Terabithia.

programme.title: Petite Maman
programme.desc: Nelly tiene 8 años y acaba de perder a su abuela. Mientras ayuda a sus padres a vaciar la casa en la que su madre creció, explora el bosque que la rodea. Allí conoce a otra niña de su edad y surge una preciosa amistad. Entre juegos y confidencias, desvelarán un fascinante secreto.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Cameron Crowe ('Casi famosos') nos presenta la historia de un ingeniero espacial (Bradley Cooper) que regresa a su hogar. Allí acepta trabajar con una piloto (Emma Stone) que le ayudará a descubrir una mejor versión de sí mismo.

programme.title: Z. La ciudad perdida
programme.desc: Prodigio narrativo de una épica abrumadora y un sentido de la aventura vibrante y expeditivo que se erige como una expecional muestra de cine clásico contemporáneo. A principios del s.XX un explorador británico se obesiona con encontrar una antigua civilización avanzada en la selva del Amazonas.

programme.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
programme.desc: Un diseñador de coches se enfrenta a toda la industria automovilística con sus revolucionarios diseños.

programme.title: Un gran equipo
programme.desc: Mirco y Fatime son los padres de Jason, un niño con autismo. Cuando la escuela aconseja a la familia de Jason que lo trasladen a una escuela especial, Fatime le pide a Mirco que actúe como padre, ya que no está muy presente en casa porque acostumbra a viajar mucho por motivos de trabajo.

programme.title: Azul y no tan rosa
programme.desc: Diego es un joven fotógrafo exitoso que vive en el glamoroso mundo de la moda, la superficialidad y el exceso. Un brutal ataque homófobo trastoca su vida cuando su pareja queda en coma. Justo en ese terrible momento, Diego, inesperadamente, debe cuidar de su hijo Armando...

programme.title: Siempre a tu lado. Hachiko
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, la película sigue la leal amistad entre un profesor y su perro Akita. Hachi espera en la estación, incluso cuando su dueño ya no regresa.

programme.title: Invisibles
programme.desc: En Nueva York, un hombre que lo ha perdido todo, incluída su casa, lucha por rehacer su vida, pasando sus días en un refugio para desamparados e intentando contactar con su hija que se ha ido distanciando de él.

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio
programme.desc: Rivales laborales descubren el amor.

programme.title: Me Quiere, No Me Quiere
programme.desc: Un mujeriego vuelve a casa por vacaciones y se enreda con la mujer que le rompió el corazón años atrás.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Selena Gomez interpreta a una chica normal cuyo viaje de verano a París resulta ser la fantasía de su vida cuando se convierte en princesa accidentalmente al asumir la identidad de otra persona.

programme.title: Siete días y una vida
programme.desc: El mundo perfecto de una bella reportera de televisión Seattle queda desmoronado por la predicción de su muerte en siete días.

programme.title: Navidades en incógnito
programme.desc: En Navidades en incógnito, Candace Cameron Bure es la Dra. Lauren Brunell, que acepta un puesto en Alaska después de perder a su novio y su prestigiosa plaza como cirujana, para aprender cómo es trabajar en un pequeño hospital rural.

programme.title: Un trabajo embarazoso
programme.desc: Thea, una joven ejecutiva, finge estar embarazada para evitar que su empresa la despida. Cuando todo el mundo multiplica sus atenciones hacia ella y empieza a recibir cada vez más ayuda, no le queda otra salida que mantener la mentira durante nueve meses.

programme.title: Un príncipe de Navidad
programme.desc: Una camarera de un pequeño pueblo y un atractivo príncipe se enamoran durante las vacaciones, pero ¿sobrevivirá su romance a la entrometida familia real de él y al celoso exnovio de ella?

programme.title: Wilde
programme.desc: Oscar Wilde es brillante y egocéntrico, genio y poeta, único en su especie y el primer hombre moderno. En el periodo de mayor creatividad de su carrera, en el que escribe algunas de sus obras más conocidas, Wilde asume su homosexualidad, lo que le supone el terrible tormento de tener que conjugar su matrimonio y sus responsabilidades como padre con el amor obsesivo que siente por Lord Alfred Douglas, un joven con el que entabla una apasionada y turbulenta relación.

programme.title: Regreso a Bountiful
programme.desc: Años cuarenta. La anciana Carrie Watts (Geraldine Page) vive en un pequeño apartamento de Houston, con su hijo Ludie (John Heard) y su nuera Jessie Mae (Carlin Glynn). Hastiada de una vida marcada por las penurias y la tristeza, la señora Watts decide volver al pueblecito donde nació, se casó y cuidó a su hijos. Se trata de Bountiful, en Texas, muy cerca del Golfo de México. Un día, sin previo aviso, Carrie se escapa y emprende el viaje.

programme.title: Miss América
programme.desc: Carnelle Scott es una huérfana acogida por sus gentiles parientes que idolatra a su prima mayor, Elain Rutledge, una exganadora del concurso "Miss Firecracker" que se celebra en el pueblo durante el 4 de julio. Decidida a seguir los pasos de Elain, Carnelle solicita la ayuda de la costurera local Popeye Jackson para prepararse para el concurso.

programme.title: Larga vida y prosperidad
programme.desc: Wendy es una chica con autismo que es incapaz de conectar con los demás. Decidida a demostrar que es autosuficiente, escapa del centro donde vive para emprender un viaje a Hollywood y presentar en un concurso un guion de “Star Trek” que ella misma ha escrito. Un viaje audaz que brinda una perspectiva única sobre la vida.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India hace que un grupo de jóvenes se cuestione sus relaciones.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos cambian cuando el profesor de filosofía es confundido un traficante de drogas.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres.

programme.title: Mi segunda vez
programme.desc: La ganadora de un Oscar Catherine Zeta-Jones (“Chicago”) da vida a una mujer que, tras descubrir que su marido la engaña, se va a Nueva York y allí se enamora de un joven que le hará descubrir que las segundas oportunidades existen.

programme.title: Frances Ha
programme.desc: Frances vive en Nueva York, aunque no tiene un apartamento. Es aprendiz en una compañía de danza, aunque no es realmente bailarina. Tiene una mejor amiga llamada Sophie, pero ahora mismo no se hablan. Frances quiere mucho más de lo que tiene, pero disfruta de la vida con alegría y despreocupación.

programme.title: Adivina quién
programme.desc: Cuando Theresa trae a su prometido, Simon Green, a casa para el 25.º aniversario de boda de sus padres, se olvida de mencionar un pequeño detalle: es blanco. Decidido a romper el compromiso de su hija, Percy Jones demuestra que el padre no siempre sabe lo que hace.

programme.title: Memorias de un hombre invisible
programme.desc: Un experimento del Gobierno fracasa y vuelve invisible a un testigo casual.

programme.title: Ámsterdam
programme.desc: Un misterio épico sobre una sorprendente trama secreta de la historia de EE. UU.

programme.title: Tess Y Su Guardaespaldas
programme.desc: Narra la relación entre Tess Carlisle (MacLaine), una testaruda e incontrolable viuda, antigua primera dama de los Estados Unidos, y Doug Hugh (Nicolas Cage), jefe del servicio de seguridad cuyo trabajo consiste en vigilarla. Doug, cansado de las excentricidades, los caprichos y el complejo carácter de la dama, ha pedido encarecidamente que lo cambien de destino, pero Tess se las ingenia para que se quede con ella de forma permanente...

programme.title: ¡Vaya vacaciones!
programme.desc: Para compensar el poco tiempo que pasa con su mujer e hijos, Bob Munro les promete un viaje a Hawai. Pero, en el último momento, cambia de idea y decide hacer una ruta por Colorado en caravana. Durante el trayecto, lleno de contratiempos, conocerán a los Gornicke, una familia con la que entablarán amistad.

programme.title: Hunt For The Wilderpeople
programme.desc: Un niño rebelde y su atolondrado tío adoptivo, quienes se adentran en el bosque luego de una tragedia familiar, ignorantes que su misteriosa desaparición marcará el inicio de una intensa persecución de parte de las autoridades.

programme.title: Peso Pesado
programme.desc: Scott Voss (Kevin James) que en su época en el instituto practicó la lucha libre, ahora es un profesor de biología de 42 años en un instituto en franca decadencia. Cuando los recortes amenazan con cancelar las clases de música y despedir al profesor a cargo de éstas (Henry Winkler), Scott comienza a recaudar dinero haciendo doblete y trabajando como luchador de artes marciales mixtas. Todos piensan que Scott está chalado, sobre todo la enfermera del instituto, Bella (Salma Hayek). Pero en su cruzada, a medida que se compromete más y más a luchar por los estudiantes, acaba convirtiéndose en un éxito de tal magnitud que logra unir a todo el instituto.

programme.title: The Warrant
programme.desc: Una orden de arresto lleva al alguacil John Breaker y al ayudante Bugle Bearclaw a cruzar el país para entregar a un criminal.

programme.title: Más valientes que los hombres
programme.desc: Más valientes que los hombres - Una familia fronteriza cruza los Estados Unidos en caravana, con la esperanza de una vida mejor en el territorio de Oregón.

programme.title: Keoma
programme.desc: Un ex pistolero mestizo de la Unión intenta proteger su ciudad natal plagada de plagas para que no sea anulada por sus medio hermanos racistas y un tirano confederado.

programme.title: Cañones para Córdoba
programme.desc: En 1916, cuando un rebelde mexicano roba cañones del ejército americano, el general Pershing envía a un grupo de inadaptados a recuperar las armas robadas.

programme.title: Condenados al infierno
programme.desc: Tras una noche de excesos en la que muere una pareja, cuatro jóvenes cargan con la culpa. Años después, los persiguen tanto sus remordimientos como un siniestro danzante que parece conocer su secreto y busca venganza. Un thriller oscuro donde pasado y castigo se entrelazan.

programme.title: Corazones salvajes
programme.desc: Wild Hearts sigue a Willow, una joven de Malibú, que busca a su padre Jack en las montañas Sierra Nevada. Entre rivales, caballos salvajes y desafíos familiares, Willow lucha por liberar al mustang Bravo y descubre la aventura, el coraje y el autodescubrimiento.

programme.title: 11 Grados de Culpa
programme.desc: 11 antiguos compañeros de colegio disfrutan de una fastuosa fiesta y se ven sorprendidos por la inesperada visita de Mónica, que no fue invitada por su escandaloso comportamiento hacia el grupo en el pasado. Esto desata el descontento y la ira de todos los presentes, especialmente de Sandra, la anfitriona. Mónica es asesinada en el jardín de la casa, lo que da lugar a una investigación. Las 11 personas son sospechosas e interrogadas, y cada una de ellas empieza a dar a la investigación un giro diferente, no para distraer de la identidad del asesino, sino para proteger a cada uno de ellos de su oscuro pasado.

programme.title: Astronauta: El Último Impulso
programme.desc: Cuando un trágico accidente interrumpe la primera misión tripulada para explorar la vida en las lunas de Júpiter, Michael Forrest debe hacer el viaje de 3 años de vuelta a la Tierra en pura soledad.

programme.title: Cabaña 28
programme.desc: Basada en un caso real, esta historia revive el infame asesinato sin resolver de Keddie. En 1981, unas vacaciones familiares se convierten en horror cuando atacantes enmascarados irrumpen en la cabaña 28. Décadas después, el misterio sigue estremeciendo.

programme.title: Mañana, cuando la guerra empiece
programme.desc: Cuando su país es invadido y sus familias secuestradas, ocho adolescentes se unen para luchar.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: Una pequeña mentira
programme.desc: Théo es un niño que vive empeñado en levantarle el ánimo a su padre, Laurent, un tipo solitario y completamente desilusionado con la vida. La oportunidad se presenta cuando Theó está a punto de ser admitido en un importante club de fútbol inglés, pero debido a su pequeña estatura es finalmente rechazado. Para no darle una mala noticia a su padre, Théo no se atreve a confesárselo, lo que da pie a una pequeña mentira que muy pronto le vendrá muy grande.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Irlanda, siglo XIX. Una mujer (Glenn Close) se ve atrapada en un triángulo amoroso inusual. Se disfraza de hombre para poder trabajar y sobrevivir, pero 30 años después se encuentra perdida en su propia prisión...

programme.title: Un largo viaje (2023)
programme.desc: Una vieja autocaravana será el nuevo hogar de Violeta y Samuel con vistas a un complejo comercial del sur de Madrid, donde tratarán de reconciliarse y hacer frente a la vida con tan solo veintidós euros en el bolsillo y “mucha imaginación”.

programme.title: La Cima
programme.desc: Mateo (Javier Rey) se enfrenta por primera vez a la montaña más peligrosa del planeta, el Annapurna, con el reto de llegar hasta la cima y cumplir así una antigua promesa. En su ascenso sufre un accidente que le deja inconsciente y gravemente herido.

programme.title: Benidorm mon amour
programme.desc: Tonet aprovecha un permiso de la mili para ir en coche con sus amigos Sento, Jaume y Tomy a Benidorm. Sueñan con disfrutar unos días del sol, las playas y, sobre todo, de las suecas y sus biquinis.

programme.title: El amor no es lo que era
programme.desc: Este film narra tres historias de amor urbanas. Álex y Lucía se encuentran, empiezan a conocerse y entre ellos surge un romance. Paz y Jorge ven impotentes cómo su relación se apaga sin saber qué hacer. Finalmente, Albert e Irene vuelven a verse tras varios decenios de separación.

programme.title: El 6º Día
programme.desc: El piloto de helicóptero Adam Gibson, después de una jornada aparentemente normal regresa a casa y se encuentra que ha sido suplantado por un clon. Cuando los creadores de su réplica descubren que no ha muerto en accidente, como habían previsto, intentan darle caza.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: Esta aventura de acción sobrenatural está basada en la aplaudida saga de Mike Mignola para Dark Horse Comics. Llevado a la Tierra por el malvado genio Rasputín (Karel Roden) para ayudar a los nazis en su causa moribunda, Hellboy (Ron Perlman) fue rescatado por el profesor Broom (John Hurt), fundador de la organización clandestina O.D.I.P. (Oficina de Defensa e Investigación Paranormal), que lo crió y desarrolló sus extraordinarias dotes paranormales. A pesar de sus oscuros orígenes, Hellboy se convierte en un inesperado paladín del bien, luchando contra las fuerzas malignas que amenazan nuestro mundo junto a un "hombre pez" telépata (Doug Jones) y una "piroquinética" (Selma Blair). Ocultos ante la sociedad a la que deben proteger, son la clave de la defensa contra Rasputín, que pretende recuperar a Hellboy para el lado oscuro y usar sus poderes para propiciar el Armagedón.
